content: Service Name Sec OC_ Tp Cancel Transmit Syntax Std_ Return Type Sec OC_ Tp Cancel Transmit ( Pdu Id Type Tx Pdu Id ) Service ID [hex] 0x4a Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different Pdu Ids. Non reentrant for the same Pdu Id. Parameters (in) Tx Pdu Id Identification of the PDU to be cancelled. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return - Type E_ OK: Cancellation was executed successfully by the destination module. E_ NOT_ OK: Cancellation was rejected by the destination module. Description Requests cancellation of an ongoing transmission of a PDU in a lower layer communication module. Available via Sec OC.h
